    g.state_name,
    COALESCE(rice.avg_rice_yield, 0) AS avg_rice_yield,
    COALESCE(maize.avg_maize_yield, 0) AS avg_maize_yield
FROM dim_geography g
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        fcm.geography_id,
        AVG(fcm.rice_yield_kg_per_ha) AS avg_rice_yield
    FROM fact_cereals_major fcm
    JOIN dim_year y ON fcm.year_id = y.year_id
    WHERE y.year = 1970
    GROUP BY fcm.geography_id
) rice ON g.geography_id = rice.geography_id

    SELECT
        fcn.geography_id,
        AVG(fcn.maize_yield_kg_per_ha) AS avg_maize_yield
    FROM fact_cereals_minor fcn
    JOIN dim_year y ON fcn.year_id = y.year_id
    WHERE y.year = 1970
    GROUP BY fcn.geography_id
) maize ON g.geography_id = maize.geography_id
WHERE rice.geography_id IS NOT NULL OR maize.geography_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY g.state_name
